name: AiLearningItem
description: A human-reviewed private learning candidate derived from a transcript correction or an administrator-selected assistant source

source_owner_email.description: Normalized private workspace owner email derived from the protected source

source_kind.description: Server-controlled provenance: transcript_correction, assistant_answer, document_guidance, support_resolution, or repeated_pattern

target_surface.description: Server-controlled prompt target: TRANSCRIPT_AND_TRANSLATION or ASSISTANT

source_session_id.description: Source transcription session id for transcript corrections

source_segment_id.description: Source audio segment id when available

source_conversation_id.description: Source assistant conversation id when available

source_message_id.description: Source assistant message id when available

source_document_id.description: Source assistant document id when available

source_support_request_id.description: Source resolved human support request id when available

source_document_name.description: Safe bounded document display name, never a raw upload URL

source_question_excerpt.description: Bounded question or source prompt excerpt shown to authorized administrators

source_answer_excerpt.description: Bounded assistant answer excerpt shown to authorized administrators

source_reference_labels.description: Safe exact page, section, or line labels from a selected document

evidence_item_ids.description: Sorted approved learning item ids supporting a repeated pattern

occurrence_count.description: Number of approved evidence items supporting this candidate

source_content_hash.description: Server-generated hash of bounded source excerpts and safe references

original_text_snapshot.description: Bounded provider text snapshot shown only to authorized administrators

corrected_text_snapshot.description: Bounded human-corrected text snapshot shown only to authorized administrators

proposed_rule.description: Bounded AI-proposed or source-derived reusable rule awaiting review

final_rule.description: Bounded administrator-edited rule used after approval

category.description: Safe learning category including transcript, assistant_guidance, document_guidance, support_resolution, or repeated_pattern

rationale.description: Short bounded explanation for why the rule was suggested

review_mode.description: Session review mode at the time of a transcript correction

session_mode.description: Session purpose at the time of a transcript correction

transcript_style.description: Transcript style at the time of a transcript correction

source_language.description: Bounded source or transcription language context

target_language.description: Bounded translation target language context when applicable

active.description: Only approved active items may enter future prompts

submitted_by.description: Server-recorded owner or administrator that submitted the candidate

approved_by.description: Normalized administrator email that approved the item

rejected_by.description: Normalized administrator email that rejected the item

dedupe_key.description: Server-generated deterministic promotion or correction key
